rules.statement: Base zoning is RA-1 (Residential Apartment, low-density).
The RA zones permit all types of urban residential development that conform to the zones' height, density, and area requirements (zone purposes provision).
rules.verbatimQuote: § 101.3: 'The purposes of the RA-1, RA-2, RA-3, RA-4, and RA-5 zones are to: (a) Permit flexibility of design by permitting all types of urban residential development if they conform to the height, density, and area requirements established for these districts'
rules.notes: Purposes provision, not a use-table row; use-table verification against official Title 11 DCMR text remains advisable.

rules.statement: Maximum permitted FAR in RA-1 is 0.9 for all structures other than public libraries (2.0).
rules.verbatimQuote: TABLE F § 201.1: MAXIMUM PERMITTED FLOOR AREA RATIO — 'RA-1 Public Library 2.0 / All Other Structures 0.9'
rules.notes: From DCOZ's consolidated export (updated 10/1/2025); official text is Title 11 DCMR.

rules.statement: Maximum FAR for Inclusionary Developments in RA-1 is 1.08; utilizing it in RA-1 requires special exception relief under Subtitle X, Chapter 9.
rules.codeSection: ZR16 Subtitle F § 201.4, Table F § 201.4; Subtitle C § 1001.3-1001.4
rules.verbatimQuote: TABLE F § 201.4 — 'RA-1 1.08'; 'provided that in all the RA-1 zones Voluntary Inclusionary Developments shall require special exception relief pursuant to Subtitle X, Chapter 9'; § 1001.3: 'RF-1, RF-4, RF-5, or RA-1 zones shall require special exception approval pursuant to Subtitle X, Chapter 9.'

rules.statement: Maximum height in RA-1 is 40 ft and 3 stories (excluding penthouse/rooftop structures).
rules.verbatimQuote: TABLE F § 203.2 — 'RA-1 40 3' (Maximum Height, ft / Maximum Number of Stories).

rules.statement: Minimum rear yard in RA-1 is 20 ft.
rules.verbatimQuote: TABLE F § 207.1: MINIMUM REAR YARD — 'RA-1 20 ft.'

rules.statement: Side yards in RA-1 scale with height: minimum distance equal to 3 inches per foot of building height, not less than 8 ft (two side yards required for multi-unit buildings with 3+ units per floor, one otherwise).
rules.verbatimQuote: 'such side yards shall have the minimum distance equal to three inches (3 in.) per foot of building height but not less than eight feet (8 ft.)'

rules.statement: Maximum lot occupancy in RA-1 is 40% for all other structures and 60% for places of worship.
rules.verbatimQuote: Table rows: 'Places of Worship 60' / 'All Other Structures 40' (RA-1).

rules.statement: Each single-household row building in RA-1 requires at least 1,800 sq ft of gross land area.
rules.verbatimQuote: 'In any of the RA-1 zones, each single household row building shall have at least one thousand eight hundred square feet (1,800 sq. ft.) of gross land area...'
rules.notes: Applies to row buildings; apartment density is FAR-driven in RA zones.

rules.statement: Residential multiple-dwelling-unit parking: 1 space per 3 dwelling units in excess of 4 dwelling units (1 per 2 in R/RF zones; reduced for publicly assisted elderly housing).
rules.codeSection: ZR16 Subtitle C § 701.5 (minimum vehicle parking table)
rules.verbatimQuote: 'Residential, multiple dwelling unit — 1 per 3 dwelling units in excess of 4 dwelling units, except as follows: 1 per 2 dwelling units for any R or RF zone...'

rules.statement: Institutional religious parking: 1 space per 10 seats of occupancy capacity in the main sanctuary (unfixed seating converted per the stated equivalents).
rules.verbatimQuote: 'Institutional, religious — 1 for each 10 seats of occupancy capacity in the main sanctuary; provided, that where the seats are not fixed, each 7 sq. ft. usable for seating... shall be considered'

rules.statement: Minimum parking requirements are reduced by 50% for sites within 0.5 mi of an operating (or contracted) Metrorail station. Whether this parcel qualifies is geographically unverified.
rules.verbatimQuote: 'reduced by fifty percent (50%)... Within one-half mile (0.5 mi.) of a Metrorail station that is currently in operation or is one for which a construction contract has been awarded'
rules.notes: Eligibility requires a distance computation the benchmark does not perform — see open questions.
